svg.title: FlyBrainLab architecture and circuits
svg.desc: The NeuroMynerva workspace in JupyterLab, the FFBO Processor routing RPCs to the NeuroArch, NeuroNLP, and Neurokernel servers, and four fly brain circuits built with English queries, each with its connectivity matrix.
svg.text: a search bar for English queries
Two more windows, an info panel and
a file browser, are not shown.
NeuroArch graph database on OrientDB, with RPC APIs
FlyCircuit, Hemibrain, Larva L1EM, Medulla 7 Column
Translates English into database queries, for example
add dopaminergic neurons innervating the mushroom body
Executes circuit models on GPUs with the
detection circuit, around a T4a neuron
Left of each pair: 3D render from the NeuroNLP window. Right: connectivity matrix, log10(N + 1) synapses between neurons. Circuits from Figure 3 of the eLife paper.
